Disclaimer: this is just a little ramble I put together, not exactly a story. Just a fun idea :) Sorry about grammar and spelling. AND I'm on mobile so sorry for that.

Buffy and Frodo.

The army of Slayers have everything under control. Without the Sunnydale Hellmouth (all blown up) to keep tabs on, and Buffy mysteriously vanishing, and Frodo Baggins showing up; they need a new mission. Giles reveals that there's a Hellmouth in New Zealand. Xander nominates Frodo as their new leader. Thus the journey begins.

Frodo is gone, and a small blonde woman has shown up with the One Ring around her neck. Buffy, unlike Xander, has not read or seen the Lord of the Rings. Gandalf isn't amused when she tries to make a gameplan while they're trapped in the Mines of Moria. And she keeps calling him Dumbledore.

Only once Gandalf saves the Fellowship from the Balrog, does Buffy realize what she must do.

With Aragorn's guidance, and Buffy's skill, they make it through Galadriel's elves and the attacks of the Uruk-hai. Buffy saves the three Hobbits. But alas, she was too late to save Boromir.

With the Fellowship at Rohan, and Gandalf the White showing up there to take on Theoden, Buffy musters a plan: She walks into Mordor.

She takes the three hobbits with her, leaving the rest to fight for Rohan.

Buffy senses a strange creature is following them. She attempts to slay him, but discovers that he is an innocent. She commands him to go away and never come back.

Buffy and the trio make it to Mount Doom. Rather quickly, as the battle at Gondor hasn't even happened. But, Gollum still has been following them.

With Buffy so near, she almost drops it in, but Gollum runs in and pushes the trio onto Buffy, knocking Pippin and Merry out. Buffy falls, throwing the ring just out of her grasp. Gollum and Sam make a mad dash for it, but Gollum gets to it first, and then grabs ahold of Sam, trying to push him into the pool of lava below.

It all comes down to this. Buffy runs to Sam, and as he falls she grabs his hand. On her belly, her torso over the side of the cliff, she holds onto Sam for dear life. Gollum jumps onto Buffy, tearing at her with all he has. The might of her Slayer strength pulls Sam back onto the cliff, but at a cost. The last strength that she has is used to push Gollum, the ring, and herself, into the pit of Mount Doom.

"Buffy Summers. She saved Middle Earth," Sam tells the Fellowship, "But... What happened to Mister Frodo?"

Xander and Frodo freak out when they find Hobbiton in New Zealand. But, there are no Hobbits there, only a film set. Frodo misses Sam. He becomes depressed, living in an abandoned Hobbiton (Willow casts a spell to rid tourists). Frodo begs Willow the Red (what he calls her, along with Willow the Wizard), to use her magic to send him back to Middle Earth.

She attempts to, but discovers through a looking spell that Buffy has died. She agrees to send Frodo back, but only after she succeeds in bringing Buffy back from the dead. Afterall, she died from a mystical volcano.
